verdict.rationale: Salesmate documents publicly available RESTful APIs, but nothing in the evidence shows a downloadable machine-readable spec. Probes of common OpenAPI and Swagger paths on apidocs.salesmate.io all returned 404. Having a REST API is adjacent to the story, not the downloadable spec it asks for.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)
